Objective: Baseline sanity test for legal UART reception
Stimulus: Send 10 legal UART frames with start bit 0, 8 data bits LSB first, and stop bit 1
Checks: Scoreboard compares rx_data against o_data; monitor checks o_valid is seen once per frame
Expected_Result: All packets match and one valid pulse is generated per legal frame
Coverage_Target: Legal frame reception and valid pulse behavior
Notes: Main smoke test for completed environment

Objective: Validate corner byte patterns and bit ordering
Checks: Scoreboard checks exact byte match; monitor confirms valid pulse per frame
Expected_Result: All directed bytes are reconstructed correctly with LSB-first ordering
Coverage_Target: Pattern bins for 00, FF, 55, AA and representative mixed values
Notes: Closes key pattern coverage in uart_tlm

Objective: Verify consecutive legal frames with minimal or no extra idle spacing
Stimulus: Send multiple legal UART frames continuously
Checks: Scoreboard checks no packet loss or duplication; monitor checks one o_valid pulse per frame
Expected_Result: All frames are received correctly without dropped or duplicated packets
Coverage_Target: Frame spacing coverage for consecutive transfers
Notes: Useful to stress state transitions from cleanup back to idle

Objective: Verify false start bit is rejected if line returns high before mid-bit sample
Stimulus: Drive RX low briefly then return high before the mid-start-bit sampling point
Checks: Monitor checks that no legal frame completes and scoreboard sees no actual packet
Expected_Result: No o_valid pulse and no packet is accepted by the receiver
Coverage_Target: Start validation coverage for rejected false start
Notes: Negative protocol test derived directly from s_RX_START_BIT logic

Objective: Verify negative-checking path using inject_err configuration
Stimulus: Enable inject_err and have driver corrupt transmitted data relative to reference transaction
Checks: Scoreboard expects mismatch between reference rx_data and actual o_data
Expected_Result: Mismatch is detected and treated as expected behavior in error mode
Notes: Depends on cfg path in driver and scoreboard being completed

Objective: Increase confidence with larger random sample count
Stimulus: Run extended randomized legal UART traffic
Checks: Scoreboard checks all packets; monitor checks valid behavior; end-of-test FIFO must be empty
Expected_Result: No unexpected mismatches, no leftover reference packets, and coverage goals are met
Coverage_Target: Random byte distribution and overall regression closure
Notes: Can reuse uart_demo_seq with increased loop count

Objective: Verify o_Rx_DV is asserted for exactly one clock cycle
Stimulus: Observe DUT output for each legal frame
Checks: Monitor or assertion checks pulse width equals one i_Clock cycle
Expected_Result: Every legal frame produces a one-cycle o_Rx_DV pulse
Notes: Best implemented as an assertion or monitor-side timing check

Objective: Verify receiver waits a full stop-bit interval before asserting valid
Stimulus: Send legal frames and measure timing from last data bit to o_valid
Checks: Monitor checks stop bit is high and valid occurs only after stop-bit interval completes
Expected_Result: No early o_valid assertion; legal stop bit precedes valid indication
Coverage_Target: Protocol timing coverage around stop bit
Notes: Complements data compare with protocol-level timing check
